units.source_text: “什么都没有，就像往常一样瞎说呢。

en.t: There was nothing at all; he was just talking nonsense as usual.

units.source_text: 不过，方才近松讲起甚三郎的故事时，传右卫门官人等听完了，都眼含热泪。

en.t: However, when Chikamatsu had just told the story of Jinzaburo, Denemon and the others listened to the end with tears in their eyes.

units.source_text: 除了这事儿——的确，这么一说，还真有个有意思的事呢。

en.t: Aside from that, though, now that you mention it, there really is something rather interesting.

units.source_text: 据说自从咱们杀了吉良官人之后，江户城内流行复仇啦。”

en.t: They say that ever since we killed Lord Kira, revenge has become the fashion inside Edo Castle.
